context: Isolated synthetic business episode; dates/amounts/contracts/people below are case-specific source facts, not new enduring Frostline policy.

records.statement: Engineer message on J-14: “needs a fan”, photo of inaccessible label, no confirmed model/serial, voltage, dimensions, part number or root-cause test. Another approved distributor has been asked for identification/pricing but has not received a Frostline PO or acknowledged delivery. Coordinator proposes booking tomorrow as “part ordered”, although shutdown/access and required controls specialist availability are not confirmed.
